statement: Self-audit run by lineagesutra-ai 0.2.0. PASS means every executed check passed; it is not a certification, a guarantee, or an independent third-party opinion. Items that were not verified are listed under "What was NOT verified".

sections.title: Lineage accuracy on the gold corpus
sections.summary: Hand-labelled corpus of 54 cases, scored on exact edge sets (column, indirect and table edges) plus required warnings. The labels were written by the author before the parser was run, so this is a regression corpus, not an independent benchmark, and it is small. Tags: basic 4/4, join 6/6, negative 11/11, expr 9/9, postgres 2/2, indirect 3/3, cte 2/2, subquery 3/3, setop 2/2, wildcard 5/5, ddl 7/7, naming 5/5, tsql 1/1, mysql 1/1, adversarial 3/3, dbt 1/1.

sections.title: Safety, integrity and adversarial inputs
sections.summary: Read-only behaviour, determinism, tamper detection, hostile files, hostile SQL, fuzzing and offline guarantees, each verified by running code during this audit.

rows: scan is read-only (source tree hash unchanged)
SHA-256 of every fixture file identical before and after scanning
output is independent of file order
forward and reversed file order give the same seal
edited node, deleted edge and forged hash all fail verification
impact is monotonic when edges are added
adding an edge never removes a finding
core and reporting contain no network or subprocess code
static check of packages/core and packages/reporting (audit.mjs excluded: it spawns the test runner on request)
HTML report escapes hostile dataset names
a dataset named <script>alert(1)</script> is rendered as inert text
Markdown report keeps hostile names inside code spans
names are wrapped in backticks, never interpreted as markup
cannot create symlinks on this host (EPERM)
a 2.1 MB file is refused (limit 2,000,000 bytes)
instructions inside SQL comments are inert data
comment text is dropped by the tokenizer and never reaches reports or agents
ambiguous column ownership never yields a definite edge
unqualified column over two undeclared tables becomes a warning
3000 seeded random token streams never crash or hang the parser
finished in 1 ms without stack overflow

sections.title: Performance (measured on this machine)
sections.summary: Synthetic workload, not your data. CPU: Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 7 155U, 14 threads.

rows: scan of 2,000 chained views over 50 tables
median 708 ms over 3 runs (min 651, max 824); 550 files, 232 KiB SQL, 19900 edges
synthetic graph has no unexpected warnings
median 1085 ms over 5 runs; 19999 downstream columns found (expected 19999)

sections.title: Package and agent-skill integrity
sections.summary: Structure, naming and secret checks over the files that ship in this package.

rows: 25 skills, each with matching name frontmatter
25 skill directories, all with valid SKILL.md
20 agent roles in manifest and .claude/agents, all files exist
20 manifest entries, 20 Claude Code agent files
README.md, LICENSE, SECURITY.md, CHANGELOG.md, llms.txt, package.json
no credentials or private keys in the tree
regex scan for GitHub, npm and AWS tokens and private-key headers (tests excluded)

sections.title: What was NOT verified
sections.summary: Listed so that absence of evidence is not mistaken for evidence.

rows: Not implemented. The built-in parser covers a documented subset and does not certify any dialect.
Live database metadata, freshness and data tests
Never attempted. No connections are opened and no rows are read.
Native activation inside Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode
Skill files are copied and checked; native invocation by each host is NOT_TESTED.
MCP Inspector / third-party MCP client validation
The MCP server is verified with a scripted JSON-RPC client only.
Independent third-party security review or penetration test
None performed. This audit is a self-audit by the project.
The SHA-256 seal detects edits; it does not prove who produced the report.

reproduce: npx lineagesutra-ai audit --root ./sql --out audit-out   # also audit your own SQL folder
git clone https://github.com/shahvatsalofficial/lineagesutra-ai && cd lineagesutra-ai && npm test && npm run proof
limits: The gold corpus is small and was labelled by the project author; it detects regressions but is not an independent accuracy claim for your SQL.
Performance numbers come from a synthetic workload on the machine that ran the audit; they will differ on yours.
A PASS here never means your database, pipelines or data are safe to change.
